N-3.4-A.skill: combine increasing/decreasing with concavity on a quarter-period of a sine or cosine graph, including a reflected curve.

N-3.4-B.skill: order values of sine or cosine at inputs spread over more than one period segment, using rise and fall of the graph rather than input order.

N-3.5-A.skill: build the equation of a sinusoid from a maximum point and the adjacent minimum point (amplitude, midline, half period to b, phase).

N-3.5-B.skill: use periodicity and midline symmetry of a sinusoid to decide which function value statement must hold at inputs far from the given points.

N-3.6-A.skill: translate a verbal list of transformations of y = sin x into an equation, handling the order of horizontal dilation and horizontal shift.

N-3.6-B.skill: locate the first maximum of a reflected or phase-shifted cosine transformation with horizontal compression, handling the sign of the leading coefficient and the scaling of the phase term.

N-3.7-A.skill: choose the cosine model that fits a described context (starting position or time of an extreme, range, period), with sign, b and shift each a common error.

N-3.7-B.skill: find and interpret the average rate of change between a maximum and the next minimum of a sinusoidal model (half a period), and avoid the full-period zero.

N-3.8-A.skill: find every vertical asymptote of a tangent with horizontal dilation and phase shift, including the spacing between asymptotes.

N-3.8-B.skill: determine whether a transformed tangent goes to +∞ or −∞ approaching an asymptote from a given side, using the signs of the stretch factor and of b.

N-3.9-A.skill: evaluate arcsin, arccos or arctan of the matching trigonometric function at an angle outside the principal range, instead of cancelling naively.

N-3.9-B.skill: evaluate a trigonometric function of an inverse trigonometric value, using the principal range to fix the sign.
